messages:
irene (docs): Quick sync — product wants a short public deprecation banner + full migration guide for v1 -> v2 text endpoints. Need owner for docs PR + code snippets. Who can take this? :wave:
kai (eng): I can draft the migration steps and troubleshooting table. Will need the canonical list of breaking changes from SDK.
sara (sdk): Breaks: header rename (Authorization -> x-rw-api-key), endpoint change (/v1/generate -> /v2/responses), payload rename prompt->input, and streaming framing update. Will drop minimal curl + JS diffs.
irene (docs): Please include curl + TS + python examples. Banner line must be <100 chars and we need email subject suggestions.
mike (product): Retirement target: alias redwood/text-legacy -> 2026-06-20 23:59UTC. We'll run a 30-day public notice starting 2026-05-21. Docs must call out fallback (alias pinning, contact sales/support).
kai (eng): infra OK for 30 days. Add oncall verification steps for rollout window. Also include 404 vs 410 guidance.
sara (sdk): Snippets (paste):
```bash
# v1
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# v2
curl -X POST -H "x-rw-api-key: $KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
```
irene (docs): Great. I'll keep a 2-line quickstart for the banner page and the full snippets in the migration appendix. Also add FAQ item: "How to find old header usage in codebases" with grep pattern.
mike (product): Banner draft: "Deprecation: v1 text endpoints retiring 2026-06-20. See migration guide." Email subject draft: "Action required: Update to Redwood text v2 endpoints"
sara (sdk): Note: Streaming behavior changes can cause partial frames on old clients; recommend SDK >= 2.1.0. I'll open a small README PR linking to the docs.
deploy-bot: text-v2 canary deployed in us-east-1 at 2026-05-03T09:12:00Z.
irene (docs): Action items: 1) kai opens docs PR with migration guide, banner copy, FAQ and troubleshooting, 2) sara adds SDK README note and snippets, 3) mike finalizes announcement timing. Target merge: 2026-05-19 so marketing has time. Please drop PR links here when ready and react :thumbsup: when reviewed. Thanks! :tada:
